projects.title: Appscripter
projects.summary: A local dashboard and CLI for backing up Google Apps Script source, with a review step before any optional publication.
projects.overview: I built a safer way to preserve script source and prepare a shareable copy while keeping linked business data outside the export.
highlights: Separate private backup and shareable-copy paths
Human review before optional Git publication
projects.outcome: The local source-backup workflow is built. No client deployment or time-savings percentage has been measured.

projects.title: Gery Robot Assistant
projects.summary: A support assistant that turns approved documents into searchable answers and guided troubleshooting, with optional model API steps.
projects.overview: The assistant keeps approved operating procedures available inside support tools and advances through troubleshooting steps without inventing missing instructions.

Optional OpenAI-compatible API calls disabled by default

projects.title: NVGS Server
projects.summary: A Django and PostgreSQL support platform with role-filtered APIs, ticket history, a notification worker, and a documented Ubuntu deployment path.
projects.overview: A shared ticket workflow needed stronger record ownership, controlled access, recoverable data, and operational checks beyond a spreadsheet-backed prototype.
highlights: Role-filtered ticket endpoints and event history
PostgreSQL-backed records with a separate retrying alert worker
Pilot with test accounts and tickets completed; deployment tasks documented
projects.outcome: A fake-data team pilot is documented. Live production import, alert delivery deployment, and measured service improvement are not claimed.

projects.title: Hotel Booking Record Review
projects.summary: Check 36,275 reservation rows for invalid arrival dates and zero-night stays, then give staff a focused list of 115 records to review.
projects.overview: A reservation-file review exercise: preserve the original, flag invalid dates and zero-night stays, and hand off a small follow-up list with a reason beside each record.
highlights: 115 records set aside for manual review
36,160 records passed the two stated checks
projects.outcome: 115 of 36,275 rows (0.32%) need review under the two named rules. This is a dataset finding, not a measured process improvement.

projects.title: Sales & Inventory Record Review
projects.summary: Filter incomplete sales lines, review possible duplicates without losing valid items, and compare sale SKUs with a separate inventory list.
projects.overview: A practical sales-file review: understand what each row represents, filter missing values by order status, identify duplicate candidates, and compare product codes across files.
highlights: 229 non-canceled lines with blank Amount; 106 with zero Qty
Six otherwise identical rows need review before removal
projects.outcome: 6,617 of 7,195 sales SKUs appear in the separate inventory list. Its date is unknown, so this cannot establish stockouts or fulfillment impact.
